pokedexEntries.bk: It has been said that they swallow those who get too close and turn them into mummies. They like to eat gold nuggets.

pokedexEntries.wh: They pretend to be elaborate coffins to teach lessons to grave robbers. Their bodies are covered in pure gold.

pokedexEntries.b2w2: Grave robbers who mistake them for real coffins and get too close end up trapped inside their bodies.

pokedexEntries.sw: This Pokémon has a body of sparkling gold. People say it no longer remembers that it was once human.

pokedexEntries.sh: There are many depictions of Cofagrigus decorating ancient tombs. They’re symbols of the wealth that kings of bygone eras had.
